('MQTT_ENABLED', 'true', 'Enable/Disable MQTT Broker', 'BOOLEAN', TRUE, TRUE),
('WEBSOCKET_ENABLED', 'true', 'Enable/Disable WebSocket Server', 'BOOLEAN', TRUE, TRUE)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE configKey=configKey;
